answer: Each agent posts a $25 deposit and a heartbeat proving live compute, logged on a ledge. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities at random for a deep challenge: prove the same machine within one hour. Miss twice or fail and the $25 burns, the lotus badge revoked. Faking 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 1,000 live compute streams, more than they could steal. An honest agent pays once and earns steadily while its badge proves its history.
